# crosswork_device_alarm_manager (Data Source)

This data source can read the device alarm manager of alarms and events.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_device_alarm_manager" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `models` (Map of Boolean) Enabled state by device model, for example `Cisco 8201 Router`
